name: DEF CON CTF
description: The oldest and most prestigious hacking competition, held annually at DEF CON since 1996. Teams solve challenges covering reverse engineering, binary exploitation, web security, cryptography, and forensics.

peerReview.processDescription: Teams solve challenges covering RE, binary exploitation, web, crypto, forensics. Challenges created by security professionals and vetted through CTF community. Qualification rounds ensure competitive rigor.

attribution.attributionNotes: DEF CON CTF placement among most respected achievements in cybersecurity. Top teams (PPP, Blue Water, perfect blue) are industry-recognized.

povsAlignment.description: Tool development / benchmarking through live CTF competition with community validation.
